svg.title: Equation 10.4-8
svg.desc: LaTeX source: \frac{\partial\mathbf{f}(\mathbf{x})}{\partial\mathbf{x}} = \begin{bmatrix} 0 & \omega_{U} & - \omega_{N}\cos\varphi_{U} & \\ - \omega_{U} & 0 & \omega_{N}\sin\varphi_{U} & \\ \omega_{N}\cos\varphi_{U} & 0 & - \omega_{N}\varphi_{E}\sin\varphi_{U} & \mathbf{0}_{5 \times 2} \\ - f_{sf,U}^{n}\sin\varphi_{U} & - f_{sf,U}^{n}\cos\varphi_{U} & J_{43} & \\ f_{sf,U}^{n}\cos\varphi_{U} & - f_{sf,U}^{n}\sin\varphi_{U} & J_{53} & \end{bmatrix}\qquad(10.4-8)
